DeterminationBasis: Existing T09 cases establish mandatory-predicate evaluation, fail-closed behaviour, bypass restraint and gate reevaluation. T11 cases separately establish consequence observation and T12 cases establish receipt/event binding. However, no existing abstract test directly establishes the specific execution-gate obligation to produce or cause preservation of one sufficient evidence record identifying the predicates evaluated, their observed values, the resulting determination, execution status and consequence status. The completeness and preservation obligation therefore remains a distinct test gap.

Existing T08 cases establish determination/execution separation, changed-state history, missing-determination handling, successor preservation, chain-boundary recording and ALLOW semantics. None directly requires every determination to preserve an inspectable attribution to both the governing state and the evidence on which that determination relied. Determination-basis attribution therefore remains a distinct positive test obligation.
